statement:
A ride-hailing app wants to send a first-ride coupon to everyone who signed up but never booked.

Return the `rider_id` and `name` of every rider with **no** booking, in any order.

Guest bookings (made without an account) are stored with `rider_id` set to **NULL**.
title: Signed Up but Never Rode
